name: 115 - API - Run Mocked End-to-End Conversation Test

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS suite_code,
        $2::TEXT AS case_code,
        $3::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $4::TEXT AS requested_by
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone
    FROM clinics clinic
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON clinic.name =
           request.clinic_name
    WHERE clinic.is_active = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

case_context AS (
    SELECT test_case.*
    FROM integration_test_cases test_case
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON test_case.suite_code =
           request.suite_code
       AND test_case.case_code =
           request.case_code
    WHERE test_case.enabled = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

gateway_context AS (
    SELECT client.*
    FROM channel_gateway_clients client
    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON client.clinic_id =
           clinic.clinic_id
    WHERE client.client_name =
          'integration-webchat'
      AND client.channel =
          'webchat'
      AND client.enabled = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT patient.*
    FROM patients patient
    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON patient.clinic_id =
           clinic.clinic_id
    WHERE patient.mobile =
          '989120000001'
      AND patient.is_active = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

inserted_run AS (
    INSERT INTO integration_test_runs (
        suite_code,
        clinic_id,
        status,
        requested_by,
        environment_name,
        metadata
    )
    SELECT
        request.suite_code,
        clinic.clinic_id,
        'running',
        request.requested_by,
        'local-mock',
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'case_code',
            request.case_code,
            'mock_ai_required',
            TRUE
        )
    FROM request_data request
    CROSS JOIN clinic_context clinic
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
          )
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM gateway_context
          )
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
          )
    RETURNING *
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM gateway_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_run
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'test_clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'test_case_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM gateway_context
        )
            THEN 'test_gateway_client_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN 'test_patient_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_run
        )
            THEN 'test_run_not_created'

        ELSE 'test_run_prepared'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_run
    ) AS run_id,

    (
        SELECT run_key
        FROM inserted_run
    ) AS run_key,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM case_context
    ) AS case_id,

    (
        SELECT case_code
        FROM case_context
    ) AS case_code,

    (
        SELECT title
        FROM case_context
    ) AS case_title,

    (
        SELECT request_template
        FROM case_context
    ) AS request_template,

    (
        SELECT expected_assertions
        FROM case_context
    ) AS expected_assertions,

    (
        SELECT clinic_id
        FROM clinic_context
    ) AS clinic_id,

    (
        SELECT clinic_name
        FROM clinic_context
    ) AS clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM gateway_context
    ) AS gateway_client_id,

    (
        SELECT client_name
        FROM gateway_context
    ) AS gateway_client_name,

    (
        SELECT channel
        FROM gateway_context
    ) AS gateway_channel,

    (
        SELECT provider_name
        FROM gateway_context
    ) AS provider_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS mobile

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode:
if ($json.success !== true) {
  return [{ json: $json }];
}

const input =
  $('Normalize and Validate Test Run').first().json;

const template =
  $json.request_template || {};

const uniqueSuffix = [
  $json.run_id,
  $json.case_code,
  Date.now(),
].join('-');

return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    test_started_at_ms: Date.now(),
    gateway_url:
      `${input.webhook_base_url}/clinic/gateway/events/process`,
    gateway_payload: {
      gateway_event_type:
        'inbound_message',
      clinic_name:
        $json.clinic_name,
      client_name:
        $json.gateway_client_name,
      provider_name:
        $json.provider_name ||
        'mock-provider',
      channel:
        template.channel ||
        $json.gateway_channel ||
        'webchat',
      api_key: '',
      signature_verified: false,
      verification_reference: '',
      source_ip: '127.0.0.1',
      external_event_id:
        `test-event-${uniqueSuffix}`,
      external_message_id:
        `test-message-${uniqueSuffix}`,
      external_conversation_id:
        `test-conversation-${$json.run_id}`,
      sender:
        $json.mobile,
      message_type:
        template.message_type ||
        'text',
      message_text:
        template.message_text ||
        '',
      attachments:
        template.attachments ||
        [],
      language:
        template.language ||
        'fa',
      request_timestamp:
        new Date().toISOString(),
      raw_payload: {
        integration_test: true,
        run_id: $json.run_id,
        case_code: $json.case_code,
      },
      webhook_base_url:
        input.webhook_base_url,
      confirm_gateway: true,
    },
  },
}];

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS run_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS case_id,
        $3::TEXT AS case_code,
        $4::TEXT AS test_status,
        $5::INTEGER AS duration_ms,
        $6::JSONB AS request_payload,
        $7::JSONB AS response_payload,
        $8::JSONB AS assertion_results,
        NULLIF($9::TEXT, '') AS error_message
),

inserted_result AS (
    INSERT INTO integration_test_results (
        run_id,
        case_id,
        case_code,
        status,
        duration_ms,
        request_payload,
        response_payload,
        assertion_results,
        error_message,
        completed_at
    )
    SELECT
        request.run_id,
        request.case_id,
        request.case_code,
        request.test_status,
        request.duration_ms,
        request.request_payload,
        request.response_payload,
        request.assertion_results,
        request.error_message,
        NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    ON CONFLICT (
        run_id,
        case_code
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        status =
            EXCLUDED.status,
        duration_ms =
            EXCLUDED.duration_ms,
        request_payload =
            EXCLUDED.request_payload,
        response_payload =
            EXCLUDED.response_payload,
        assertion_results =
            EXCLUDED.assertion_results,
        error_message =
            EXCLUDED.error_message,
        completed_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

updated_run AS (
    UPDATE integration_test_runs run
    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN request.test_status =
                 'passed'
                THEN 'passed'
            ELSE 'failed'
        END,
        completed_at = NOW(),
        summary =
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'case_code',
                    request.case_code,
                'passed',
                    request.test_status =
                    'passed',
                'duration_ms',
                    request.duration_ms,
                'assertion_count',
                    JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(
                        request.assertion_results
                    )
            )
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE run.id = request.run_id
    RETURNING run.*
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_result
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.test_status =
             'passed'
            THEN 'integration_test_passed'
        ELSE 'integration_test_failed'
    END AS result,

    request.run_id,
    (
        SELECT run_key
        FROM updated_run
    ) AS run_key,

    request.case_code,
    request.test_status AS status,
    request.duration_ms,
    request.assertion_results,
    request.response_payload,

    (
        SELECT summary
        FROM updated_run
    ) AS run_summary

FROM request_data request;
